description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's behavior when reading tree objects with confusing or problematic path names, especially focusing on edge cases like special characters, case sensitivity, and path ambiguities.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks their outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after the test.
